title: Standby capacity census — quick tally and asks
body:
Purpose: quick, ad-hoc spreadsheet used this week to map short-term standby GPU and human coverage for cross-functional launches + emergency fallbacks. Intended for fast handoff (5–10 min read) and to surface immediate asks.

Notes on usage: fill 'Confirmed' column before EOD, update estimated burn with real burner rates from metrics team (see linked artifacts), ping owners for swap requests.

HEADER (columns): Region | Route/Endpoint | Typical peak qps (p50) | Standby GPUs (count + type) | Standby humans (primary) | Backup human | Expected burn (USD/hr) | SLA tier | Last tested (dd/mm) | Confirmed

ROWS:
1) US-WEST | chat-api-prod / v2/generate | 420 qps | 2xA10G | Maya Chen | Rohit Desai | $32/hr | gold | 05/13 | pending
2) US-EAST | text-embed / embeddings-batch | 150 qps | 1xA10G + 1xT4 (warm) | Ellen Park | Jonah Rivera | $18/hr | silver | 05/10 | confirmed
3) EU-CENTRAL | hosted-gpt / fallback-lite | 85 qps | 1xT4 (standby) | Lukas Mayer | N/A | $9/hr | bronze | 04/29 | pending
4) APAC-SE | rerank-route / batch | 40 qps (bursty) | 0 GPUs (cold start) | Priya Nair | Ellen Park | $6/hr (if cold) | silver | 05/02 | needs-approval
5) US-WEST | realtime-chat-low-latency | 220 qps | 1xA10G (hot-standby) | Miguel Soto | Maya Chen | $16/hr | platinum | 05/15 | confirmed
6) EU-WEST | analytics-summarize | 70 qps | 1xT4 | Anya K. | Jonas L. | $8/hr | bronze | 05/01 | pending
7) US-CENTRAL | private-customer-burst | 12 qps (scheduled) | 1xA10G reserved | Customer-ops (TBD) | SvcEng oncall | $24/hr | enterprise | 05/11 | partial
8) APAC-NORTH | fallback-model-q2 | 95 qps | 1xA10G + 1xT4 (warm) | R&D standby | Platform Eng | $30/hr | gold | 05/14 | confirmed
9) LATAM | embeddings-light | 22 qps | 0 GPUs (routes to US) | Regional-CS | SRE rotation | $0 (proxied) | bronze | 03/20 | proxy
10) EU-CENTRAL | surge-canary | 10 qps | 0.5 fraction (shared burst) | Launch PM | SE-team lead | $4/hr | silver | 05/16 | needs-ops

Quick observations (free-text):
- Two US routes (rows 1 & 5) are currently underprovisioned for sustained 95th percentile peaks — both marked pending for owner confirmation. Recommend +1 A10G hot for 72 hours around next push.
- APAC-SE currently has no standby GPU; for the scheduled rerank experiment we should either pre-warm a T4 for 6 hours or route traffic to EU for the trial window. Ops estimate for warm: ~30 min to reach stable KV cache.
- EU-CENTRAL fallback tested 05/13 showed 8% latency regression vs prod model; annotate in notes and consider rolling canary to T4-only mode for 24h.

Immediate asks (owners + due dates):
- Maya: confirm US-WEST A10G allocation (due 2026-05-19).
- Ellen: coordinate with Metrics to publish actual burn-per-token for embed routes (due 2026-05-20).
- Platform Eng (Jonah): verify regional KMS access for private-customer-burst (row 7) and unblock by 2026-05-21.
- SRE: run 15-min surge test on EU-CENTRAL fallback during low-use window (2026-05-18 morning). Add result link back into this sheet.

One-off analysis quick calc (back-of-envelope):
- If we spin +1 A10G hot for US-WEST (row 1) for 72 hours: incremental cost = 72 * $16/hr = $1,152. Expected reduction in P99 errors ~ 60% (based on prior burn tests). ROI: justified for launch window if expected revenue impact > $1.2k.

Open questions / loose ends:
- Who owns cross-region routing policy if capacity unavailable (auto-fallback vs manual)? Current default: auto-fallback to nearest compatible model; need to confirm with product-hosted-api.
- Is there a short-term budget line we can draw from for emergency standby GPUs this week? Finance contact: Claire Holt (cc).

Logistics / quick changelog:
- 2026-05-17 created by Maya (initial scan)
- 2026-05-18 updated rows 1/5 after SRE spike log
- 2026-05-19 added Jonah and Ellen as collaborators, updated confirmed flags

Small print: this is an informal working tracker — do not use as canonical capacity record for month-end billing. Move confirmed allocations into Dedicated capacity tracker after final approval.
